messages:
jess: Heads-up — apse1 and us-west2 are seeing a big backlog in the GPU attach queue. Scheduler backlog spiking, lots of pods stuck in ContainerCreating >2m.
infra-bot: ALERT: attach-controller.queue_length=412 (5m). median_attach_latency=95s, attach_timeouts=32, spike_start=2024-09-07T15:02:30Z. https://metrics.redwood/attach-controller/last5m
omar: I think this is the async attach path getting hammered after a short network blip to the block-storage RPC endpoint. Attaches are timing out and re-queued, which makes the queue worse.
liam: sample log from attach-controller: ```[2024-09-07T15:03:05Z] attach-controller: pod/foo request attach gpu-0 -> err=timeout after 30s, retry=1/5, queue_len=389```
sasha: Are we sure it's not hitting cloud provider attach quota or ENI limits? Which AZs exactly?
jess: Not quota. It's concentrated in apse1b and us-west2-c. Cloud quotas look fine. We're seeing attach RPC latencies to the storage controller spike; kubelet attach timeout fires, controller retries, creates a retry storm.
nora: Short-term mitigations: (1) temporarily increase attach RPC timeout from 30s -> 90s, (2) add jittered exponential backoff on retries, (3) throttle concurrent attach workers in attach-controller for affected AZs. Which one do we want first? :thinking_face:
omar: I'd do bumping timeout + throttle workers as immediate patches. Jittered backoff next deploy. Also a rolling restart of attach-controller in apse1 to clear stuck goroutines.
liam: Plan I can run: create hotfix branch -> update configmap for attach_timeout & max_concurrent_attaches -> canary deploy in apse1a -> promote. I'll open PR now.
sasha: Also flag: scheduler churn is making it worse. Pods get tainted/migrated which triggers another attach cycle. We should pin lower-priority jobs during the incident to avoid cascade.
jess: Good call. I'll cordon/taint a small set of non-critical nodes and scale up warm GPU pools by 20% in apse1 and us-west2 to reduce fresh attach demand. Also adding an api-server rate-limit on attach-controller requests to 50rps as a temporary safety valve.
infra-bot: ACTION: hotfix canary started for attach-controller in apse1a (build 1234). Link: https://ci.redwood/hotfix/1234. Notifying oncall.
nora: Post-incident action items: add metric attach_retries_per_pod, surface attach_rpc_latency per-AZ, and add runbook section for "attach retry spiral". Also test jittered backoff in a soak cluster.
omar: I'll follow up with the PR and attach perf graphs once canary runs. Keeping an eye on queue.
liam: Canary looks stable after config bump, queue reduced to ~40. Rolling to rest of apse1 now.
sasha: After rollout, let's run a small evacuation test to verify no re-triggering of attach storms.
jess: Thanks all — opening incident ticket and linking this thread. Will post runbook link when I finish the writeup. :white_check_mark:
